The supplied text gives inconsistent hardness-feature significance descriptions: generally ≤2σ outside the core, marginally >2σ in the dynamics discussion, and ∼3σ in the conclusions.
The EMU core-flux sentence prints 943 GHz, whereas the survey setup states 943 MHz; preserve the flux measurement without silently correcting that sentence.
The southern mass in the kinetic-SZ paragraph lacks an explicit power of ten and unit; it is unsuitable as a complete numeric answer key.
Do not interpret the radio-halo upper limit as a detection or the dust fit as an unambiguous dust measurement.
